integrity: The complete labeled connected graph domain through six vertices is enumerated. Connectivity is cross-checked by breadth-first search and union--find; all-pairs distances are cross-checked by repeated breadth-first search and Floyd--Warshall; conflict graphs are quotient-checked under all vertex relabelings; and representative degree, eccentricity, and farness vectors are recomputed exactly.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive classification covers connected simple undirected graphs through six vertices only. The sharp six-vertex threshold concerns distinct unique maximum-degree and minimum-eccentricity vertices; set-level disagreement already occurs through ties at five vertices.
title: Six vertices are the sharp split between a unique hub and a unique graph center
